Record Class DashboardController.StatCardsJson

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.controller.DashboardController.StatCardsJson
Record Components:
playbackValue - formatted value of today's playback duration
playbackUnit - "Hours" or "Minutes"
avgValue - formatted value of the average session length
avgUnit - "m" or "s"
todaySong - the Top Song Today label
todayAlbum - the Top Album Today label
weeklySong - the Top Song This Week label
weeklyAlbum - the Top Album This Week label
Enclosing class:
DashboardController

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
